description: A record and playback head, writing what arrives at IN while sending out what was already under it; it runs while touching a group of modules with a Memory or MemoryCV at the left-hand end

params.text: Unlit, the head wraps round to the other end of the buffer when it reaches an edge; lit, it turns round at the edge and carries on recording backwards
Moves the record head through the buffer by hand and springs back to centre when let go; recording stops while it is being moved
Latches; the head records while it is lit
Sets the position the head takes the first time it runs after the patch loads, 0V to 10V across the buffer
Lit, the head travels backwards through the buffer; the head runs at one fixed speed in either direction

inputs.text: A high gate records and a low gate stops
The left channel written into the buffer under the head; with no cable patched the head writes 0V and erases what was there
The right channel written into the buffer under the head; with no cable patched the head writes 0V and erases what was there
Each time this voltage changes the head jumps to that position in the buffer, 0V at the start and a shade under 10V at the end

outputs.text: Channel one is the position of the head as a phasor, 0V at the start of the buffer and 10V at the end; channel two is the position in seconds, which the menu can drop
The left channel of what is in the buffer under the head, for sending through effects or a mixer and back into the IN jacks
The right channel of what is in the buffer under the head, for sending through effects or a mixer and back into the IN jacks

notes: it records nothing until a Memory or MemoryCV is the left-most module of the touching group it is in; the small light near the top edge is lit while it is attached
running with nothing patched to the IN jacks it writes 0V, erasing the part of the buffer it passes over
the display below the CURRENT output shows the position in seconds and hundredths, or in minutes and seconds once the buffer passes 60 seconds
menu: Zero the outputs when not playing — drops L and R to 0V when recording stops; unset, they hold the value they stopped at
Have 2nd channel of seconds on CURRENT — adds or removes the second channel of that output, which carries the position in seconds
